entities.name: Scion of the Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Legendary dragon avatar on Dominaria active during the Temporal crisis, believing itself the blood of the Ur-Dragon.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: Ancestor dragon through whose spirit all dragons gained might, magic and intelligence.

entities.name: Temporal crisis of Dominaria
entities.description: Crisis during which the Scion was active.

relations.note: Feels a visceral bond and believes itself its blood.
relations.quote: believes itself to be the blood of its powerful ancestor
